integrity: All displayed identities are derived from the printed map using invariance of logarithmic coordinate coboundaries and strict Jensen equality conditions. Numerical specializations are exact decimal evaluations of symbolic bounds.
scientific_limitations: Applies to compact invariant probability measures supported strictly inside the positive quadrant.
Provides necessary all-amplitude recurrence constraints, not existence, uniqueness, ergodicity, or stability.
Does not certify convergence of finite numerical trajectories to an invariant measure.
title: Exact Jensen-gap mean bias in a discrete fear–Allee predator–prey model
